# Reading through a pool

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`reading-through-a-pool` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](reading-through-a-pool.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the rule reads the fast configuration only through what a pool reads of it, two courses with one rule at a reading step, read alike by the pool there, have one rule after it: rules part at a reading step only where the pool's reading parts.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With h x g = H (read x) g, one rule and one reading of the pool at a reading step give one rule after it. (`Becoming.Pace.rule_through_pool`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the two-layer course of Pace with the rule read through a map of the fast configuration.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an actual rule reads through a pool, or which pool.
